name: FLOWERS -Le volume sur automne-
source:
[url=https://vndb.org/c16866]Yatsushiro Yuzuriha[/url], president of the school's Council of Nicaea, knows the truth hidden within the school. The silver-haired beauty seeks to prevent [url=https://vndb.org/c16861]Suou[/url] from reaching it by giving her what seems like an impossible task—take over the role of president and she'll hand over the key to what she desires.
However, Yuzuriha is harboring her own secret, buried deep within herself...

As the leaves turn and strange incidents continue to plague the isolated Saint Angraecum Academy, interweaving threads of emotion tangle together in an intricate story of love and truth.

This is the third game in the Flowers visual novel series from Innocent Grey, renowned for its beautiful artwork, engaging stories, and complex characters. 

[Taken from [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1238730/Flowers_Le_volume_sur_automne/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
[url=https://vndb.org/c16866]八代柚叶[/url]，学校尼西亚理事会主席，知道隐藏在学校内部的真相。这位银发美女试图阻止[url=https://vndb.org/c16861]Suou[/url]实现这一目标，她给了她一项看似不可能完成的任务——接管总统的角色，她将交出她想要的钥匙。
然而，柚叶却隐藏着自己的秘密，深埋在自己的内心深处……

随着树叶的转动和奇怪的事件继续困扰着孤立的圣安格莱库姆学院，情感的线索交织在一起，形成了一个关于爱与真理的错综复杂的故事。

这是Innocent Grey的Flowers视觉小说系列中的第三款游戏，该系列以其精美的艺术作品、引人入胜的故事和复杂的角色而闻名。

[取自 [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1238730/Flowers_Le_volume_sur_automne/]Steam[/url]]
